name: Animal Friend
source: Ultimate Campaign pg. 62, Legacy of Fire Player's Guide pg. 7, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 331
body:
Drawbacks
Animal Friend
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 62, Legacy of Fire Player's Guide pg. 7, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 331
Category Race
Requirement(s) Gnome
You’ve long been a friend to animals, and feel safer when animals are nearby. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Will saving throws as long as an animal (Tiny or larger, must be at least indifferent toward you) is within 30 feet, and Handle Animal is always a class skill for you.
